algorithm: Gaussian copula with declared shared normal factors and inverse CDF mappings

dimension_consumers.time_orientation: program start quantile;EV ready-early versus defer preference
dimension_consumers.routine_stability: machine shift willingness only:1-routine_stability;not reduced by manual-burden sensitivity
dimension_consumers.manual_burden: handling variation and extra-intervention preference;independent of machine shift willingness
dimension_consumers.thermal_level: cooling preference only;not tied to early/late time preference
dimension_consumers.autonomy: experimental confirmation preference within original permission

class_cores.A: 关注节省，重视解释和可靠性，调整先确认
class_cores.B: 舒适和生活便利优先，不因小额节省接受明显打扰
class_cores.C: 自主决定、当天确认、可以撤回
class_cores.D: 积极响应，明确边界内支持自动优化
class_cores.E: 照护、舒适和生活稳定优先，默认建议与确认
class_cores.F: 出行和目标电量优先，支持边界内充电优化

Gaussian_copula_transform.use: correlated latent uniforms;not empirical household fitting

class_cores.use: fixed household core;members never redraw A-F

cooling_support_C.use: explicit household preference support first;EB class soft support only if absent;not heating/off authority;40C cooling-off sentinel is not a comfort preference

latent_marginals.use: relative preference coordinates,not acceptance probabilities or population frequencies

loading_default.use: shared latent loading;pairwise latent correlation is loading squared;0.7 remains a pilot starting point

time_domain.source: original machine windows,release/deadline,program duration,operator rights and calendars
time_domain.use: one frozen quantile mapped to dated local domain;date/offset retained;no modulo-clock union;unsupported A projection explicitly pending

temperature_step_C.use: discrete-uniform cooling preference grid inside EB support

authorization_confirmation_threshold.use: D/F may prefer confirmation above this autonomy coordinate;never grants absent standing permission

member_context_mapping.use: member-wide coordinates are latent baseline only;active device opinion uses the existing device draw for its declared reference member,existing member draw for other affected people;explicit declarations condition all opinions;no new draws or consensus

willingness_mapping.use: soft negotiation range inside original declared reschedule bound;not acceptance,hard authority or a B admission filter

thermal_mapping.use: soft desired maximum change;no heating,off or preconditioning permission

device_mechanism_preferences.use: dryer waiting sensitivity=manual_burden;hot-water readiness=comfort_sensitivity;EV readiness=1-time_orientation;all evaluation context only

handling_mapping.formula: manual_burden >= 0.5 denotes stronger aversion to handling changes
handling_mapping.use: separate handling preference;does not itself reduce machine shift willingness or grant operations

shared_declaration_priority.use: explicit shared habit/range/shiftable declaration before sampled defaults;EB defaults remain fallback references,not overrides

temporal_summary.use: legacy weekday/weekend A target only if every dated target in the period agrees at day-offset0 and no row is missing;otherwise original A input retained and pending reason recorded

primary_handler_scope.use: dated local candidate conditions on original registered handler;another qualified person is not assumed to cooperate;missing primary opportunity is not proof of household infeasibility

device_opinion_scope.use: programs:routine/handling;AC:cooling level/comfort sensitivity;water:readiness;EV:routine/readiness;retain affected member opinion without averaging or acceptance label

service_date_precedence.use: prefer original service date when a complete local candidate exists;otherwise earliest feasible later date allowed by original deadline;only then map stable early/late quantile within that day;late clock preference is not assumed cross-day willingness
